# holiday-cn

Source: https://github.com/NateScarlet/holiday-cn

Bundled data: `assets/holidays/2026.json`, retrieved 2026-09-17 from the repository's annual JSON.
License: MIT (included in this directory and runtime package).

2026 notice: https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7047091.htm
Official government republication checked against the complete holiday and working-day list:
https://www.beijing.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengcefagui/202511/t20251104_4258873.html

Only the user-initiated holiday update downloads subsequent annual JSON data. Empty/unannounced years do not replace cached notices. Lunar festival names and solar terms are calculated offline by lunar-python.
